name: qlrisk_price_total_return_swap
title: Price a TotalReturnSwap
description:
Price one Total Return Swap (qlrisk TotalReturnSwap): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), notional (amount; default 1000000), spread_bp (basis points, 25 = 0.25%; default 0), initial_price, ticker (default SPX), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, issuer, coupon_pct, spot, position, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
